Name: Brown Harvest Moon Cows
Author: bluestarkiller
Description:
[size=5][b]**UPDATE! Content Patcher version loaded Just drop this file in your Mods folder and you'll be good to go (make sure you have content patcher installed too).**[/b][/size]

This is a cosmetic mod to change the brown cows in the game to the adorable chubby Harvest Moon cows. Because who doesn't love chubby cows?
Both baby and grown up cows will be modfied.

I've also posted a content patcher version of the white cow originally by Chrysanthe (Link: http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/224/) All credits go to Chrysanthe for converting the original white cow sprite sheet to work with SV.


Please endorse if you like this mod!
